name: creative
description: Creative writing under hard constraints (checked automatically): acrostic, six-word story, lipogram, required words with a length limit, forbidden words, rhyme endings, dialogue form, titles, style transfer.

tasks.title: Acrostic RIVER
tasks.prompt: Write a short poem of exactly five lines about a river. The first letters of the lines must spell RIVER. Output only the five lines.

check.tests:
lines=[l.strip().lstrip('*_ ') for l in answer.strip().splitlines() if l.strip()]
assert len(lines)==5, lines
assert ''.join(l[0].upper() for l in lines)=='RIVER', [l[:12] for l in lines]

tasks.title: Six-word story
tasks.prompt: Write a six-word story about a lost key. Exactly six words, nothing else.

check.tests:
import re
w=re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9'’-]+", answer)
assert len(w)==6, w
assert any('key' in x.lower() for x in w), 'no key'

tasks.title: Sentence without 'e'
tasks.prompt: Write one sentence of at least 12 words about the sea that does not contain the letter e (neither upper nor lower case). Output only the sentence.

check.tests:
import re
s=answer.strip()
assert 'e' not in s.lower(), 'contains e: '+s
assert len(re.findall(r'[A-Za-z]+', s))>=12, 'too short'

tasks.title: Story with required words
tasks.prompt: Write a very short story of 50 to 80 words that uses the words lantern, pirate and algorithm. No title, output only the story.

check.tests:
import re
w=re.findall(r"[A-Za-z'’-]+", answer)
low=answer.lower()
assert 50<=len(w)<=80, len(w)
for need in ['lantern','pirate','algorithm']:
    assert need in low, 'missing '+need

tasks.title: Storm without the obvious words
tasks.prompt: Describe a thunderstorm in exactly three sentences without using the words rain, thunder, lightning or storm (in any form). Output only the three sentences.

check.tests:
import re
s=[x for x in re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+', answer.strip()) if x]
assert len(s)==3, s
low=answer.lower()
for bad in ['rain','thunder','lightning','storm']:
    assert bad not in low, 'uses '+bad

tasks.title: Couplet with given endings
tasks.prompt: Write a rhyming couplet (two lines) about hope. The first line must end with the word light, the second with the word night. Output only the two lines.

check.tests:
import re
lines=[l.strip() for l in answer.strip().splitlines() if l.strip()]
assert len(lines)==2, lines
ends=[re.findall(r'[A-Za-z]+', l)[-1].lower() for l in lines]
assert ends==['light','night'], ends

tasks.title: Dialogue form
tasks.prompt: Write a funny dialogue of exactly four lines between A and B about a robot learning to cook. Lines alternate and start with 'A:' or 'B:' (A first). Output only the four lines.

check.tests:
lines=[l.strip() for l in answer.strip().splitlines() if l.strip()]
assert len(lines)==4, lines
assert [l[:2] for l in lines]==['A:','B:','A:','B:'], [l[:4] for l in lines]
assert all(len(l)>6 for l in lines)

tasks.title: Five titles
tasks.prompt: Give five creative titles for a science fiction novel about bees, as a numbered list from 1. to 5., each title at most six words, no explanations.

check.tests:
import re
lines=[l.strip() for l in answer.strip().splitlines() if l.strip()]
assert len(lines)==5, lines
for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
    m=re.match(r'^%d[.)]\s+(.*)$'%i, l)
    assert m, l
    t=m.group(1).strip('*_" ')
    assert 1<=len(t.split())<=6, t
assert len(set(l.lower() for l in lines))==5

tasks.title: Style transfer
tasks.prompt: Rewrite this sentence the way a pirate would say it, as one sentence: 'The meeting is postponed to Monday.' Output only the sentence.

check.tests:
import re
s=answer.strip().strip('"')
assert 'monday' in s.lower(), 'Monday missing'
assert re.search(r'\b(arr+|ahoy|matey|aye|ye|me hearties|landlubber|savvy|avast|shiver)', s.lower()), 'not piratey'
assert len([x for x in re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+', s) if x])==1, 'more than one sentence'
assert s.lower()!='the meeting is postponed to monday.'

tasks.title: German rhyme
tasks.prompt: Schreibe einen deutschen Zweizeiler über Kaffee. Die erste Zeile endet auf 'Morgen', die zweite auf 'Sorgen'. Gib nur die zwei Zeilen aus.

check.tests:
import re
lines=[l.strip() for l in answer.strip().splitlines() if l.strip()]
assert len(lines)==2, lines
ends=[re.findall(r'[A-Za-zÄÖÜäöüß]+', l)[-1] for l in lines]
assert [e.lower() for e in ends]==['morgen','sorgen'], ends
assert 'kaffee' in answer.lower(), 'no Kaffee'
